cells: South face of a modest white clapboard house with boarded windows, no door, grassy foreground and trees; overcast daylight
Dusty attic inside the white house, low wooden beams, only a dark stairwell descending, no rope or knife or loose props
Forest path through tall deciduous trees with one climbable large tree beside the path, no nest visible from ground level
View from a fork high in a large tree over forest foliage, broad branch in foreground; no nest or egg baked into the plate
Dense deciduous forest with confusing similar trees and undergrowth, daylight, no unique route markers
Small grassy forest clearing enclosed by trees, neutral ground with no grating, leaves pile, or secret entrance visible
Featureless cramped stone dead end in a twisty underground maze, warm lamp light and identical grey rock, no props
Twisty little underground passages all alike, branching grey stone tunnels, no unique signs, treasure or markers; intentionally generic to preserve the maze puzzle
Canyon viewpoint from the very top of an immense rocky canyon, river far below, forest at back, daylight, descending footpath along side
Rocky ledge halfway down a vast canyon, paths continue both upward and downward, daylight
At bottom of a vast canyon beside cold flowing river, steep rock walls rise high overhead, narrow climbable path up side, daylight
Deep underground canyon viewed from a rocky path, natural stairway descends away, no bridge or dam control visible, warm lantern foreground and cold shadows
North end of an ancient large underground temple, huge marble pillars toward north, granite west wall, faded indistinct inscription on east wall above descending stair; no bell
South end of the same temple with bare altar, a small dark hole in floor; no candles or book
Underground Egyptian burial chamber, ascending staircase west, empty central floor for separate coffin, no loose treasure
Ancient chamber filled with faded Atlantean murals, sloping passage upward, damp stone, no trident or treasure
At the upper periphery of a huge stone dome, continuous wooden railing overlooking a floor far below, no rope attached
At floor below the same huge dome, white marble pedestal standing empty at center, high wooden railing along dome perimeter, stairway descends through prominent doorway, no torch or rope
Outside massive gateway into an underworld, stone gate arch, dim inherent illumination, neutral open threshold with no visible spirits or magic barrier, no text
Desolate land of lost souls, dim inherent light, old skeletal remains stacked in a corner, northern passage out; no skull treasure distinct from background, no gore or visible ghosts
Long narrow north-south corridor briefly narrowing even further, bare grey stone, lamp foreground
Cold stone passage with frost-damp walls, low ceiling, subtle breathlike haze with no visible person
Winding stone passage around a blind bend, no fixtures, no objects
Twisting rocky passage dropping slightly around an irregular curve, no fixtures or objects
Particularly damp cave with west and east openings and an impossibly tiny crack on southern wall, damp bare earth
Small underground cave with a narrow exit and a dark stair down, bare grey rock, no objects
Low stone cave with worn ancient engravings, no readable text, northwest and east passages, empty floor
Small foul-smelling underground chamber, stained damp stone, no gas haze suggesting poison, no objects
First-person view just above fast cold river water between tall white rocky cliffs, no boat edge or buoy painted into scene, rushing water no waterfall immediately ahead
Long narrow beach beneath towering white cliffs beside cold river, no boat or loose props
Broad sandy river beach at foot of cliffs, path leads inland northeast, no shovel or boat or buoy
Small sandy cave near river, deep unmarked sand floor reserved for excavation state, no scarab visible
Rocky shore at edge of cold river, land path away from water, no boats or treasures
Footpath beside gently flowing small stream from west to east, rock and moss, no treasure
View along narrow gently flowing stream between close banks, no boat or props
At the base of an enormous concrete dam beside river, massive dam wall towers above, no inflated raft or pile of plastic
Southern shore of large underground reservoir filled with dark water, opposite bank distant, broad rocky margin, no treasure
Northern shore of same filled underground reservoir, sloping rocky bank and exits behind viewer, no pump
First-person surface-level view on dark reservoir water between cavern banks, no boat or treasure
Drained underground reservoir, exposed cracked mud and shallow puddles, both banks connected by muddy basin, no jewel trunk visible
Top walkway of enormous grey concrete dam, parapets, blank foreground area reserved for control panel, no bolt or controls baked in, reservoir visible only as a distant dark band
Dusty institutional dam lobby with concrete walls and exits north and south, no guidebook or matchbook
Cramped dam maintenance room of grimy concrete and metal pipes, empty wall area reserved for separate buttons and leak, no wrench screwdriver controls or water flooding baked in
Large reverberant underground chamber, high walls and upward stair, damp rock, no platinum bar, no readable text or visible soundwaves
Rough entrance into an old underground coal mine, narrow tunnel goes inward, no equipment
One of several indistinguishable narrow coal-mine tunnels, dark seams in grey rock, no unique signposts or objects
Top of a long vertical wooden ladder descending through a rocky mine shaft, warm lamp foreground, bottom unseen
Bottom of same long ladder looking up into shaft, rough coal-dark rock and small side passage, no coal pile or tools
Timber room deep in mine, tight rough walls and low narrow crack to west, no loose timber in plate
Small drafty underground chamber with a shaft overhead and passage south, empty space for separate basket
Upper shaft room with a deep shaft opening and beam overhead, no basket or torch or chain props
Small underground machine room with bare central stone floor reserved for separate machine, industrial grime on walls, no machine or switch in plate
Small coal-mine gas chamber, grey rocky walls and dark floor, no visible gas cloud or bracelet or flame
Small squeaky mine chamber with irregular walls, no visible creatures or props
Low-ceilinged rocky bat chamber, empty ledge for separate figurine; no bat painted in background
Stone room with top of a steep smooth metal slide descending into blackness, no movable objects
Large rough stone chamber with low northern passage and stairs leading up, a solid east wall reserved for dynamic opening; no Cyclops, food or bottle
Large treasure hideout with solid granite east wall and stair leading down, empty floor without sacks or thief or valuables
Long straight narrow passage ending at a rough opening, sparse stone, no doors or treasures
Small subterranean chamber below forest floor, overhead opening reserved for separate iron grating; no grating or key or leaves baked in
View beside a great waterfall at canyon's end, drifting spray in sunlight, no rainbow painted in, no sceptre or gold
Rocky ground near opposite side of waterfall, spray drifting across distant canyon, no rainbow or pot of gold
View high above a canyon gorge looking toward far bank, waterfall below and sky beyond, neutral foreground reserved for separate rainbow walkway; no bridge
Outside a massive ancient stone barrow in a forest clearing, open dark doorway in east face; no parchment or symbols or text
Large square underground stone room with tall ceiling and enormous intact mirror filling south wall, exits on other three sides, mirror reflects only empty stone room, no adventurer
Exact same square stone room but enormous mirror is broken into shards, no intact reflective sheet, no adventurer
An enormous bright cavern inside the final stone barrow, wide stream through its center, small wooden footbridge to dark tunnel beyond, no sign or text
Same open forest clearing as neutral generic clearing but a small dark opening in earth in foreground, no grating or leaves
